subject: science
topicName: How Do You Know a Reaction Happened?
description: A self-paced Grade 10 chemistry lesson on observable indicators of chemical reactions and how to distinguish chemical changes from physical changes using evidence.
learningObjectives: Describe five common indicators that may signal a chemical reaction has occurred
Distinguish chemical changes from physical changes using observable evidence
Explain why one observation alone is not always enough to prove that a new substance formed
Use everyday examples such as rusting, bubbling, browning, spoiling, and temperature change to identify possible reactions
prerequisites: Basic properties of solids, liquids, and gases
Physical changes such as melting, freezing, boiling, and dissolving
Chemical changes can form new substances
